title: verdict-scorer output (v11 PQ-coverage, issue #110)
description: evidence/verdict.json produced by verdict-scorer v11. Validates PQ-coverage verdict shape and rejects old-shape keys (classification, attribution) via additionalProperties: false. Source: agents/verdict-scorer.md.

source.description: Must be 'verdict-scorer' to identify the producer

queried_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp of when the verdict was produced

sample_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the analyzed sample (64 lowercase hex chars)

analysis_verdict.description: Core verdict: PQ coverage completeness and correctness. additionalProperties: false rejects old-shape keys (classification, attribution, maliciousness, named_actor, etc.).

complete.description: true when every primary_question has an answered fact meeting C0a/C0b requirements

correct.description: false when any contradiction is detected (two PROVEN facts on same topic without resolution)

unresolved.description: Question IDs that are not answered (gap in evidence)

contradictions.description: Same-topic PROVEN facts without supersedes or CONFLICT resolution

degraded.description: Self-honesty notes about evidence gaps (fail-closed per issue #78)

evidence_strength.description: strong = all PROVEN-FULL no contradictions; mixed = some gaps/degraded; weak = major gaps or multiple unresolved

ignored_evidence.description: Facts or evidence files that exist but were not relevant to PQ coverage

open_questions.description: Manual-verification items or areas needing further analysis

answered.description: true if a PROVEN-FULL fact answers this question per C0a/C0b

cited_fact.description: Fact ID that answers this question, or null if unanswered

confidence_band.description: Confidence band of the cited fact (e.g. PROVEN-FULL), or null

gap.description: Human-readable explanation when not answered; null when answered

question.description: Primary question ID where contradiction was detected

nature.description: Description of what contradicts between the two facts

affected_question.description: Question ID affected by this degradation, or null if general
